summary: A Google DeepMind researcher announces the launch of a Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber model designed to be used with the Code Mender harness to help software defense teams find and fix vulnerabilities.

practices.reason: A named, shipped model variant targeted at vulnerability discovery and remediation is relevant to any team doing security-focused code analysis, but no benchmark or evaluation is given.
practices.quote: Great to see launch of the Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber model! 🛡️

practices.reason: Pairing a model with a dedicated harness for vulnerability discovery is a scaffolding pattern worth tracking, but the post gives no implementation detail about how the harness works.
practices.quote: By combining Gemini Cyber with the Code Mender harness, we're giving frontline software defense teams a head start to efficiently uncover and secure critical vulnerabilities in complex production systems.
